shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' package.json && sed -n '1,260p' app/Dashboard.tsx && rg --files app components lib test tests __tests__ 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,300p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort | sed -n '1,400p' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,400p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && sed -n '401,800p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,320p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "git log --oneline --decorate -8 && git show HEAD:app/Dashboard.tsx && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git diff -- package.json package-lock.json next.config.ts app/Dashboard.tsx app/page.tsx && wc -l node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && rg -n \"fetch\\(|Promise\\.all|JSON\\.stringify|Analytics|Notifications|Settings\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"relative URL|absolute URL|Route Handler|Route Handlers|fetching from.*API|fetch.*route\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/backend-for-frontend.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,300p' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -type f -path '*fetch*' -o -type f -path '*headers*' | sort | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' app/Dashboard.tsx && git diff --check && git diff -- app/Dashboard.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .gitignore && find .next -type f | wc -l && find .next -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n '1,40p' && sed -n '1,120p' next-env.d.ts && ls -lh tsconfig.tsbuildinfo"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/Dashboard.tsx tsconfig.json'
